clues.it: Marta era nella 4ª colonna, nella 1ª riga e a nord di Fabio.
clues.en: Marta was in the 4th column, in the 1st row and north of Fabio.

clues.it: Luca era nella 5ª colonna, in una stanza diversa da Vito e nel Saloon.
clues.en: Luca was in the 5th column, in a different room from Vito and in the Saloon.

clues.it: Bruno era accanto a una sputacchiera, ma non era accanto a uno sgabello da saloon.
clues.en: Bruno was beside a spittoon, but was not beside a saloon stool.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Anna era nella 9ª colonna, nella 5ª riga e nella stessa stanza di Carla.
clues.en: Anna was in the 9th column, in the 5th row and in the same room as Carla.

clues.it: Sergio era in una stanza diversa da Marta e nell'Ufficio dello Sceriffo.
clues.en: Sergio was in a different room from Marta and in the Sheriff's Office.

clues.it: Carla era nella 7ª riga e accanto a uno sgabello da saloon.
clues.en: Carla was in the 7th row and beside a saloon stool.

clues.it: Vito era nella 8ª riga, a ovest di Anna e nell'Ufficio dello Sceriffo.
clues.en: Vito was in the 8th row, west of Anna and in the Sheriff's Office.

clues.it: Giada era accanto a un abbeveratoio e in una stanza diversa da Sergio.
clues.en: Giada was beside a water trough and in a different room from Sergio.

clues.it: Irene era a ovest di Giada.
Fabio era nella 2ª colonna, nella 11ª riga e a ovest di Anna.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 2nd column, in the 11th row and west of Anna.

general_clues.en: 5 in the west half of the grid.
